nodes.label: Ropey rope buffers
nodes.desc: All text lives in ropey 1.6 ropes (simd feature); ChangeSet splices them instead of copying strings.

nodes.label: Transaction & ChangeSet
nodes.desc: Transaction wraps a ChangeSet (Retain/Delete/Insert ops) plus the resulting Selection — one undoable unit.

nodes.label: Selection & Range
nodes.desc: Kakoune-style model: a Selection is one or more Range{anchor, head} with a designated primary.

nodes.label: tree-house syntax
nodes.desc: Syntax wraps tree-house layers: incremental reparses from a ChangeSet, 500 ms parse timeout.

nodes.label: Grammar loader
nodes.desc: Locates and loads compiled tree-sitter grammar shared libraries for each language.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.desc: One open file: rope text, per-view selections, change history, syntax tree, LSP attachment.

nodes.label: Editor
nodes.desc: Holds all documents and views, config, and the EditorEvent queue consumed by the app loop.

nodes.label: Application event loop
nodes.desc: tokio::select! over signals, terminal input, job callbacks, status messages, futures and editor events.

nodes.label: Commands & keymaps
nodes.desc: MappableCommand enum: normal-mode editing commands that build Transactions from the selection.

nodes.label: LSP Registry
nodes.desc: SlotMap of LanguageServerId to Arc<Client>; merges every server's incoming calls into one stream.

nodes.label: LSP Client
nodes.desc: One language server process: async JSON-RPC request/notify transport with timeouts.
